items.title: Evan Engram didn’t catch either of his two targets in the Broncos’ Week 12 loss to the Steelers.
Pat Freiermuth caught his only target for one yard in the Steelers’ Week 12 win over the Broncos.
items.text: Freiermuth didn’t have his first target until the beginning of the fourth quarter. The 28-year-old was a consistent target of Aaron Rodgers, but he didn’t appear to have much of a rapport with Mason Rudolph in their first game together. Freiermuth can’t be trusted as more than a low-end TE2 for Week 13 against the Texans. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Pat Bryant caught 4-of-7 targets for 42 yards in the Broncos’ Week 12 loss to the Steelers.
Courtland Sutton caught 1-of-8 targets for four yards in the Broncos’ Week 12 loss to the Steelers.
Rico Dowdle rushed 11 times for 71 yards in the Steelers’ Week 12 win over the Broncos while catching one pass for three yards.
Michael Pittman caught 1-of-2 targets for seven yards in the Steelers’ Week 12 win over the Broncos.
Jaylen Waddle caught 5-of-8 targets for 53 yards in the Broncos’ Week 12 loss to the Steelers.
items.text: It’s far from one of Waddle’s best games of his career, but when you consider how atrocious Bo Nix was Friday, it’s considerably more impressive. He wasn’t able to get deep down the field, but he was without hyperbole the only relatively effective offensive option for the Broncos in Week 12. He’s a WR4 for the upcoming match against his former employer in the Dolphins in Week 13. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Germie Bernard caught 1-of-2 targets for 58 yards in the Steelers’ Week 12 win over the Broncos.
items.text: Bernard set up the Steelers’ only offensive touchdown with his long connection with Mason Rudolph. That was his only contribution, however, as Pittsburgh relied heavily on the run game as they built a big lead and didn’t appear to have a ton of trust in Rudolph in the rainy weather. Bernard doesn’t have much fantasy upside for the remainder of the year, and that includes his Week 13 showdown against the Texans. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Jaylen Warren rushed 20 times for 46 yards in the Steelers’ Week 12 win over the Broncos.
items.text: Warren and Dowdle received all 31 rushing attempts as the Steelers relied heavily on the run game in Mason Rudolph’s first game as a starter. The 28-year-old tailback didn’t find much room, however, and this is back-to-back-to-back clunkers for Warren. He’ll try and get things going in Week 13 when Pittsburgh squares off against the Texans. - Christopher Crawford

items.title: Jonah Coleman rushed 15 times for 26 yards in the Broncos’ Week 12 loss to the Steelers while adding eight catches for 46 yards.
items.text: Coleman was able to “save” his fantasy afternoon thanks to some checkdowns and screen passes, although outside of a 17-yard connection it was all for minimal yardage. The 23-year-old found zero room on the ground against the Steelers’ front seven, and plodding wouldn’t be an inaccurate description. Coleman has looked the part for most of the year and has a good chance to rebound in Week 13 against the lowly Dolphins, but this was ugly. - Christopher Crawford
